subject: Conflict involving concrete grade beam clashing with the underground electrical duct

messages.text: The concrete grade beam clashing with the underground electrical duct bank, the plumbing sanitary main, and the mechanical condensate drain routing at Gridline D/7 needs resolution before we can release for fabrication. This needs immediate attention; multiple trades are blocked. A response within three weeks would be appreciated.

Hold fabrication release at Gridline D/7 pending a coordination sketch for the concrete grade beam clashing with the underground electrical duct bank, the plumbing sanitary main, and the mechanical condensate drain routing.
